description: This file defines the interface for the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory class, which is a factory class responsible for creating various IPlayerTask instances related to media playback operations within the Rialto server media framework. It includes method declarations for creating tasks such as attaching samples, handling media sources, processing bus messages, and controlling playback states.

classes.name: IGenericPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: An interface class that provides factory methods for creating various media playback tasks in the Rialto server media framework.

methods.name: createAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a task to attach media samples to the player, given the context, player, and media segments.

methods.name: createAttachSource
methods.description: Creates a task to attach a media source to the player.

methods.name: createDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Creates a task to handle the event when a deep element is added to the pipeline.

methods.name: createEnoughData
methods.description: Creates a task to handle the event when enough data has been received from the source.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to handle end-of-stream (EOS) event for a media source.

methods.name: createFinishSetupSource
methods.description: Creates a task to finalize the setup of a media source.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle a GStreamer bus message.

methods.name: createNeedData
methods.description: Creates a task to handle the need-data signal from a source.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start or resume playback.

methods.name: createReadShmDataAndAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a task to read shared memory data and attach samples.

methods.name: createRemoveSource
methods.description: Creates a task to remove a media source.

methods.name: createReportPosition
methods.description: Creates a task to report the current playback position.

methods.name: createCheckAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Creates a task to check for audio underflow conditions.

methods.name: createSetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Creates a task to set the playback rate.

methods.name: createSetPosition
methods.description: Creates a task to set the playback position.

methods.name: createSetupElement
methods.description: Creates a task to set up a GStreamer element.

methods.name: createSetupSource
methods.description: Creates a task to set up a media source.

methods.name: createSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Creates a task to set the video display geometry.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the playback volume.

methods.name: createSetMute
methods.description: Creates a task to mute or unmute the audio.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the player.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop playback.

methods.name: createUnderflow
methods.description: Creates a task to handle underflow conditions.

methods.name: createUpdatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Creates a task to update the playback group with a typefind element and caps.

methods.name: createRenderFrame
methods.description: Creates a task to render a video frame.
